title: Crossing the Red Sea
summary: God can make a way when His people cannot see one. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read Exodus 14:10-31 and look for how this passage teaches: God can make a way when His people cannot see one.

tell_it: Israel was trapped between Pharaoh's army and the sea. God opened the sea, and His people crossed on dry ground.
understand_it: God can make a way when His people cannot see one. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: Crossing the Red Sea reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Faith matters.
age_8_11_explanation: Crossing the Red Sea shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: God can make a way when His people cannot see one.
teen_explanation: Crossing the Red Sea gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that god can make a way when His people cannot see one. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: God can make a way when His people cannot see one.
Faith means trusting God enough to respond.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when faith is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: What did God open for Israel?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: The Red Sea. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that god can make a way when His people cannot see one.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember Exodus 14:21 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in Crossing the Red Sea?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Path Through Water
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: God can make a way when His people cannot see one.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from Crossing the Red Sea. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
